subject.title: improve(setup): keep WSL operations inside the app-owned directory

question: Should SetupEngine accept the documented same-user check-to-use race and intentionally reject previously accepted custom distro names as the permanent security boundary?
rationale: Tests support the proposed boundary, but the remaining race and backward-incompatible name policy are deliberate security and compatibility choices that code review cannot authorize on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Accept with live proof
options.body: Accept the documented race and stricter names after current-head live WSL install, cleanup, and rollback proof confirms the guarded behavior.

options.title: Preserve broader compatibility
options.body: Revise the validation policy to preserve additional safe existing distro names and add focused compatibility coverage before merging.

options.title: Require a stronger boundary
options.body: Pause the PR until a maintainer-approved design further narrows the check-to-use window or avoids recursive deletion in the affected flow.

recommendation.title: Accept with live proof
recommendation.body: Accept the documented race and stricter names after current-head live WSL install, cleanup, and rollback proof confirms the guarded behavior.
